title: Mayor of Marechal Floriano impeached as deputy takes office
seoTitle: Marechal Floriano Mayor Impeached, Deputy Takes Over
subtitle: The City Council approved the impeachment of Lidiney Gobbi, and Deputy Mayor Junior Lovatti takes over the municipality
excerpt: The Marechal Floriano City Council impeached Mayor Lidiney Gobbi following allegations of bidding irregularities, and Deputy Mayor Junior Lovatti took office.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The decision of the Marechal Floriano City Council to impeach Mayor Lidiney Gobbi has had a major impact in the mountain region, increasing searches for information about the deputy mayor who will take over the municipal leadership.

impeachment of mayor lidiney gobbi

The extraordinary session held on Friday (25) unanimously approved the final report of the Investigating Committee, which recommended the impeachment of 64-year-old Lidiney Gobbi (PP).

complaint and bidding manipulation

The process was initiated following a complaint by Júlio Alberto Armelau, received on November 5, 2025, which pointed out alterations in the dates of bidding notices published between July and October 2025. The dates were allegedly replaced with random years—such as 2000, 1980, 1972, and 2022—with the goal of making it difficult for interested parties to locate the proceedings.

council decision and defense arguments

The council members considered that the court injunctions suspending the progress of the case did not invalidate the 90-day deadline, maintaining the proceedings. The defense claimed a technical error in the dates and questioned the dual role of Diogo da AMAR as both complainant and rapporteur, but the report concluded that the changes were deliberate.

deputy mayor junior lovatti takes office

With Gobbi's impeachment, Deputy Mayor Junior Lovatti (PL) takes over the leadership of the Marechal Floriano Municipal Government, as provided by municipal legislation.

local political repercussions

The change of command occurs in a municipality where Gobbi was elected in 2024 with 4,087 votes (36.6%). Lovatti's rise could cause political instability, as pointed out by defense attorneys during the session.

With information from Século Diário.
